goal: Test whether causal flare history from issued NOAA SGAS products, added to the fixed 96 magnetic summaries, raises window precision at the project operating point (prior-year threshold at window recall 0.90, config/operating-point-v2.json).
provenance: Every SGAS product carries an :Issued: time (nominal 0245 UTC) and lists the previous UT day's energetic events with NOAA region number and X-ray class, plus the X-ray background. This replaces the blocked solar event reports, which carry only an archive :Created: time (docs/history-publication-probe-20261107.md).
availability_rule: A window at forecast time t uses only SGAS products whose issue time is <= t - 30 minutes. Regional events are those whose NOAA number is in the HARP's NOAA_ARS on the forecast date. A HARP without a NOAA number, or with no SGAS issued in the preceding 75 hours, has history_available = 0 and missing regional values; absence is never encoded as quiet. Spans are measured on issue time: 1d = 27 h, 3d = 75 h.

features.history_available: 1 if the HARP has a NOAA number and at least one SGAS was issued in the last 75 h
features.reports_3d: number of SGAS products issued in the last 75 h
features.hours_since_issue: t minus the latest issue time, if within 27.5 h
features.reg_c_1d / reg_c_3d: C-class events of the HARP's regions in products of the last 27 h / 75 h
features.reg_mx_1d / reg_mx_3d: M- or X-class events, same spans
features.reg_events_3d: all listed events of the regions (with or without X-ray class), 75 h
features.reg_max_logflux_3d: log10 peak flux of the largest regional event, 75 h; missing if none
features.reg_mx_life: M/X events of the regions in every earlier product
features.reg_max_logflux_life: log10 peak flux of the largest regional event in every earlier product
features.disk_max_logflux_1d: largest full-disk event in the latest product
features.xray_background_log: log10 of the X-ray background in the latest product

candidates.definition: Frozen baseline probabilities with the prior-year threshold at recall 0.90. No refit.
Refit of the unchanged walk-forward-v1 recipes on 96 summaries plus history_available, reports_3d, hours_since_issue. Isolates refitting and availability from content.
Same refit on 96 summaries plus all 15 history features.

training: Annual folds of helio24.walk_forward.annual_fold; fold audits must equal the frozen baseline. Models, hyperparameters, calibration and the 0.45/0.55 weight are those of config/walk-forward-v1.json. Thresholds come from calibration-year probabilities at window recall 0.90 and are hashed before any evaluation label is read.

acceptance.all_year_primary: per_year_primary holds in all six years for the same candidate
acceptance.attribution: A pass of history that flag does not share is attributed to flare-history content.
acceptance.result_meaning: A pass justifies only a separate prospective protocol. It never changes alerts, thresholds or models.

limits: SGAS lists energetic events, not every C-class flare; archived text may differ from the bytes first issued; NOAA_ARS is the definitive JSOC association. Already inspected years: adaptive development, not an independent test.
prohibitions: No evaluation labels in any feature, fit or threshold
No feature or hyperparameter change after results
No SGAS issued after t - 30 minutes
